scope: Three independent local processes; UDP/TCP loopback only
statusMeaning: Domain status is roadmap completeness. implemented entries below are bounded behaviors, not whole-domain certification.

domains.name: Shared Semantic Core

implemented.behavior: Ten runtime-shaped object projections
RCL transaction/migration/route/recovery predicates

notImplemented: Universal cross-protocol ABI and governed evolution

domains.name: Subject and Identity

implemented.behavior: Stable subjectId and continuityRoot across local node migration
Pinned Ed25519 local identity, optional Windows current-user DPAPI cold recovery

notImplemented: Public enrollment, cross-device identity recovery, credential rotation lifecycle, delegated representation

domains.name: Naming and Addressing

implemented.behavior: TINP capability address
Stable subject reference separated from legacy node-bound URI

notImplemented: Global stable naming, authority resolver, node-independent public discovery

domains.name: Discovery and Presence

implemented.behavior: Signed discovery responses across real hops
TINP directory TTL and callable provider checks

notImplemented: Dynamic enrollment, Internet presence distribution, adversarial-scale discovery

domains.name: Intent and Capability Negotiation

implemented.behavior: Real upstream CHP and RCP via bounded Python process
Exact profile version and contract matching
One Chinese intent grammar

notImplemented: General intent understanding and ecosystem-wide capability composition

domains.name: Authority and Sovereignty

implemented.behavior: Signed scoped read-only lease
RCL transaction and migration guards
Signed monotonic local revocation watermark, durable recovery synchronization and expiry
Opt-in external AAF operator approval for whole-lease pending retirement; pinned SPKI fingerprint, exact challenge and scope, bounded time and current caller-supplied revocation metadata
implemented.evidenceLevel: Local independent signer process, CLI and real crash tests; not production human enrollment

implemented.behavior: Opt-in authority registry policy and signed append-only member key rotation/revocation with role-specific keyring projection
implemented.evidenceLevel: Local independent issuer process, CLI and positive/negative lifecycle tests; offline caller-supplied files, not production registry custody

implemented.behavior: Opt-in offline authority registry distribution bundle with distinct mirror threshold and deterministic signed-fork rejection
implemented.evidenceLevel: Local independent issuer and mirror processes, CLI and positive/negative quorum tests; no online publication or durable cross-host convergence

implemented.behavior: Opt-in offline authority registry convergence history with Genesis/contiguous sequence, previous-root continuity, stable mirror-set and duplicate/fork rejection
implemented.evidenceLevel: Local independent issuer and mirror processes, CLI and positive/negative historical tests; caller-supplied finite history, not online transparency or durable cross-host convergence

notImplemented: Online registry publication, trusted time, transparent history, durable cross-device convergence and lost-key recovery
ownerBoundary: AAF approval format/signature retained; TINP narrow adapter only

domains.name: Trust Evidence and Provenance

implemented.behavior: Node-signed execution receipts
Optional authority-signed event log with DPAPI checkpoints and protected replay cache; partial rollback rejection
Request/result/authority/route root binding
Signed authority registry sequence/previous-root provenance and immutable member fingerprint mapping
implemented.evidenceLevel: Local independent issuer lifecycle and strict keyring mapping tests; no trusted timestamp or distributed agreement

implemented.behavior: Same-call mirror receipts bind one registry root/sequence and caller-selected threshold; conflicting signed roots fail closed
implemented.evidenceLevel: Local three-mirror bundle/demo, CLI and strict fork/quorum tests; offline observation only

implemented.behavior: Finite convergence history binds ordered distribution bundles with a historyRoot and detects sequence gaps, broken predecessor roots, duplicate/fork snapshots and mirror-set drift
implemented.evidenceLevel: Local two-snapshot issuer/mirror demo, CLI and strict historical tests; supplied-history observation only

notImplemented: Distributed durable agreement, trusted timestamping, production retention controls

domains.name: Routing and Path Selection

implemented.behavior: TINP graph multi-hop and alternate path
Conjunctive cost/latency/energy/region/bandwidth search
RCL final route admission using trusted observations

notImplemented: Distributed routing convergence, production metrics, global routing governance

domains.name: Session and Continuity

implemented.behavior: Signed local session
Provider/source migration with RCL preservation
Identity/authority/evidence continuity under tested faults
Windows cold restart preserving keys/session/revocation and node receipts; unresolved pending intent fails closed without re-execution
Offline redacted pending inspection, maintenance-only historical reconciliation, explicit whole-lease retirement after three signed durable revocation acknowledgements; no resend or lease renewal
implemented.evidenceLevel: Windows local runtime and real coordinator crash tests

notImplemented: Cross-device re-enrollment/transfer, whole-directory anti-rollback without external anchor, side-effect transactions

domains.name: Transport Adaptation

implemented.behavior: Real UDP and TCP loopback providers
Bounded framed messages and fault controls
Actual send-rate throttling

notImplemented: QUIC, TLS, WebSocket, NAT traversal, authenticated public transport enrollment

domains.name: Resource SLA and Value

implemented.behavior: Signed cost/latency/energy/region/retention budget fields
RCL route limits
Provider SLA declaration marked guaranteed=false

notImplemented: Metered billing, quota federation, guaranteed SLA, settlement

domains.name: World and Data Context

implemented.behavior: worldId binding and no-authoritative-action policy

notImplemented: RNCS/RFE runtime adapter, world sync, data lifecycle and privacy enforcement

domains.name: Application Seed
notImplemented: Application seed format, cross-platform installation/distribution and seed verification
ownerBoundary: UNDECIDED: reuse existing seed owner after audit

domains.name: Runtime Capability and Lowering

implemented.behavior: Fixed RCL programs execute through canonical compiler and JS runtime
One pure provider executes in node processes

notImplemented: Device-runtime negotiation, application lowering and general hardware capability adaptation

domains.name: Private Network and Isolation
notImplemented: VPN/tunnels, subject/world-level private network enforcement; test link blocking is not this protocol

domains.name: Legacy Interoperability
notImplemented: DNS/HTTP/TLS/browser/application compatibility adapters; using UDP/TCP does not implement migration protocol
ownerBoundary: Existing Internet protocols retained; future adapter boundary
